title: Compiler and Hardware Co-Design for Accelerator Architectures
summary: Heterogeneous accelerator architectures offer an efficient path to performance for compute-intensive workloads. However, full-stack integration remains difficult. We present EAAC (Extensible Accelerator Architecture), a flexible and extensible compiler and hardware architecture designed to lower the overhead of hardware-compiler co-development for rapid prototyping of hardware accelerators.
